reviews.comment: Dr. Smith's lectures are very interesting and are great if you are specifically interested in microbiology. He is also very responsive to emails and questions. His exams aren't bad, and are solely based off of lecture. If you go to class and pay attention, you'll do ok; Just make sure you write everything he says, as the questions can be specific.
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Smith is a very passionate and intelligent individual, but not a good teacher. Said exams would be over broad concepts, but almost every question was very specific. He is very tangential in lectures, leaving him to rush through slides as class time runs out. The order of topics taught seemed disorganized, with rough transitions between subjects

Course is difficult but doable, graded 70/30 lecture/lab. Lab is easy and assignments and lab exams worth close to nothing (don't stress). Lecture exams Qs come from lecture slides, 3 exams + 1 comp final, exams can be difficult, averages around 75, about 85% of final Qs come from prior exams (avg 88%). 

You can do well just takes some studying.
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Such a nice and intelligent professor but it is pretty hard to stay engaged and pay attention in lecture. Lots and lots of slides but all questions for the exams are on the slides so as long as study the slides, you're good. No exam reviews. Lab portion worth a significant portion. Final is old exam questions so not too hard. Extra credit sometimes

good prof overall but his lectures can get slow making it hard to take notes, and his tests are full of random concepts from the slides that he'll occasionally stress in lecture. lab exams are honestly harder than lecture and only three exams + final makes it tough to keep an A in the class
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I would say his class is not hard, but not having much HW or assignments to help study does not help. You could study one set of slides and not a single question from that set would be in it. It does not help that his only grades are exams. His lecture are also long, but interesting. He loves his microbiology, but to do well you have to work for it
Lectures are really boring, exam questions are very specific on answer choices so make sure you study the many slides he has and go to class. No HW or other resources provided to aid in studying.

Lectures are boring but he does tell you to focus on certain slides for the exam. Exam questions are really specific so know all the details from all 300 slides given for that exam. No study resources were provided beyond the slides. good luck.

Lectures were very boring and read straight off the slides mostly. The exams were random stuff from the slides and there were no study guides or practice exams. The final is optional and old exam questions.

You can't predict what's on the exams & he's a terrible lecturer. He couldn't answer any questions & there was no review. No hw or extra credit, but you'll wish there was hw. He did curve a 88.6 to an A if you attended majority of his classes. I only did well because I had a smart study group & the final was all old exam questions. RUN IF U CAN.

Dr. Smith is a great professor! If you go to class, take good notes, and study hard you should do great! He tells you what to study for exams and is always willing to answer questions! There is a lot of material for the exams but if you study early you should be fine. He also curves the exams and is a great lecturer! Highly recommend!
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Smith is knowledgeable! Lectures exams are doable once you get accustomed to the types of questions he asks!

Class is tough but doable. 3 exams and final is optional (cumulative) but will replace lowest exam grade. Grades .5 and above round up (ex. 89.5 rounds to A). Exams are multiple choice with 4 options each question. Recommend going to office hours and SI for help! Overall pretty nice professor just a tough course.

Dr. Smith has good lectures, sometimes it can be hard to stay present. However, his lectures and exams go really well together, and everything on there will be something you have seen before. Be prepared for trick questions though. Also, every point counts in lab (he does not run it), it sucks.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Passionate about the subject which makes him a great lecturer. Isn't the most enthusiastic prof you'll meet but he teaches you what is important. Grades based on 3 tests and a final which can replace your lowest exam and lab assignments. Lecture 70% and Lab 30% His exams are very fair MC and he teaches everything you need to know. Takes attendance.

Professor Smith's lectures were a little monotone, but they made a lot of sense. His exam questions all come from the lectures, so be sure to pay attention and take notes. We were graded by discussion questions and two exams. The final was optional and replaces the lowest test grade but I didn't take it since the exams were pretty easy.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Smith is a good prof in terms of he teaches you what you need to know for his exams. With that being said, he isn't the most engaging prof, but you will learn a lot. He does care about his students, and if he is going too fast and you tell him, he will slow down. He has his quirks - an example being "Chipolte" instead of "Chipolte". Good guy.
